goal: Review a pull-request diff and return actionable findings ordered by severity.
guardrails: Do not flag style preferences as blockers.
If a finding is uncertain, say so instead of stating it as fact.
Keep the review under 600 words unless the diff is large.
inputs: Context: what the change is for
name: code-review
outputs: One-paragraph verdict: approve, approve with nits, or request changes
steps: Read the full diff and the linked issue or ticket, if any.
Check for correctness bugs, security issues (injection, secrets, auth), and API/contract breaks first.
Check for maintainability: dead code, missing tests, unclear naming, performance traps.
Return findings grouped as Blocker / Should fix / Nit, each with file, line, and a concrete suggestion.
